title: Evaluating the Inclusiveness of Artificial Intelligence Software in Enhancing Project Management Efficiency – A Review

bias_targets.methodology: Proposed evaluation through a Unified Inclusiveness Score (UIS) that aggregates inclusiveness audits, usage tracking across diverse demographic groups, and real-time bias monitoring.
Assessed by evaluating the cultural sensitivity of the AI systems and the implementation of cultural competence training as part of the Unified Inclusiveness Score framework.
Evaluated by assessing the language support and multilingual capabilities of the AI tools to ensure effective communication across diverse linguistic backgrounds.
Measured by evaluating accessibility criteria, specifically checking if the AI systems incorporate features like screen readers and voice commands for users with disabilities.

Addressed by evaluating AI Decision Transparency, algorithmic bias detection, and training on diverse datasets to mitigate human project management biases like optimism bias, the planning fallacy, and anchoring.
